news.title: Europe Blows Up Russian Soyuz Rocket Launch Site in French Guiana
news.snippet: Europe dismantled the Soyuz-ST launch complex in French Guiana, repurposing infrastructure for MaiaSpace's reusable rocket program.

news.title: Russian Soyuz Launch Infrastructure Blown Up in French Guiana
news.snippet: The launch pad for the Russian Soyuz-CT rocket at the European Kourou spaceport in French Guiana has been dismantled using a controlled explosion.
